name: Captured in the Dark
source:
Follow the story of Julie, a young workaholic who makes a single mistake which sets her on a path that will change her life forever. Falling into the hands of a ruthless criminal organization she will have to endure physical and psychological abuse beyond her wildest imagination.

Will she accept her hopeless situation or fight for whatever twisted version of love can be found in this dark place?
Once all hope is gone will her forced submission turn her into a new person or just the shell of one?

[From [url=https://laharl12.itch.io/captured-in-the-dark]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随年轻工作狂朱莉的故事。她只犯下一个错误，就踏上了永远改变人生的道路。落入冷酷无情的犯罪组织手中后，她必须忍受远超想象的身体与心理虐待。

她会接受绝望的处境，还是为这个黑暗之地中可能找到的、无论多么扭曲的爱而抗争？
当一切希望消失，被迫的屈从会让她变成另一个人，还是只剩一具空壳？

[摘自[url=https://laharl12.itch.io/captured-in-the-dark]itch.io[/url]]
